use quote::{format_ident, quote, ToTokens};
fn main() {
    let name = format_ident!("Record{}", 17u32);
    let fields = [format_ident!("one"), format_ident!("two")];
    let values = [13u32, 29u32];
    let tokens = quote! { struct #name { #( #fields: u32 ),* } fn values() { #( let #fields = #values; )* } };
    println!("{}", tokens);
    let nested = quote! { module::#name { #( #fields: #values ),* } };
    println!("{}", nested.to_token_stream());
    let text = "a\n\"b";
    println!("{}", quote! { #text });
    let empty: [u8; 0] = [];
    assert!(quote! { #(#empty)* }.is_empty());
}
